rv.q: The Niceties is brilliant, posing questions that raise eyebrows and making us take a long, hard look at how we even got here as a nation.
Though the play is set a decade ago, the conversations between Zoe and Janine are repeated today as American history continues to be scrutinized and curricula rewritten.
This play will nicely live in my mind for a long time.
This intense, raw play leaves the conversation to be addressed, with an incredible production which needs to be felt – a must see.
